item.title: Backend Financial API & Observability Stack
item.author: sebian.vandespiegle@student.odisee.be (Sebian Van de Spiegle)
item.description: Applied Skills: FastAPI, Python 3.10+, Docker Compose (Dual Dev/Prod setup), PostgreSQL, REST API Architecture, In-Memory Caching & Limiting, JWT Authentication & Refresh Tokens, DevSecOps (Bandit SAST, Trivy Container Scanning, Gitleaks, Sigstore Cosign), HashiCorp Vault, Enterprise Observability (Custom ASGI Prometheus Metrics, Jaeger OTel Spans, Loki Direct Logging Handler, Grafana Dashboards, Alertmanager Webhooks), E2E Test Automation (Bash).
